fields.acceptance: A testscript resumes an interrupted plan run whose record change set has landed and the run goes on past its stopped step; in the same suite rhiza run resume still exits non-zero naming the state and rhiza run abandon for a plan run whose change set is withdrawn and for a build run whose change set has landed (run-resume-unaccepted.txtar keeps passing), each journal unchanged
fields.statement: rhiza run resume continues an unfinished plan-workflow run whose change set has landed (a plan run lands its record during the interview), while it still refuses a plan run whose change set is rejected, withdrawn or superseded, and any other workflow's run whose change set is no longer in flight
